const r = await tools.exec_command({
  cmd: "set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, re
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.').resolve()
task=root/'.ai/task/repair-w24-20260923'
window=root/'evidence/quality/repair-window-24-20260923'
pack_root=window/'orchestration'
manifest_path=task/'PACK-MANIFEST.json'
m=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert (window/'orchestration-pack-manifest.json').read_bytes()==manifest_path.read_bytes()
for x in m['files']:
    src=root/x['source']; dst=pack_root/x['relative_destination']
    sb=src.read_bytes(); db=dst.read_bytes()
    assert db==sb, ('pack-copy',x['relative_destination'])
    assert len(db)==x['bytes'], ('pack-bytes',x['relative_destination'])
    assert hashlib.sha256(db).hexdigest()==x['sha256'], ('pack-sha',x['relative_destination'])
assert sum(1 for p in pack_root.rglob('*') if p.is_file())==len(m['files'])
candidate=root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window24-20260923-candidate-catalog'
for src in sorted(p for p in candidate.rglob('*') if p.is_file()):
    rel=src.relative_to(candidate); dst=root/rel
    assert dst.read_bytes()==src.read_bytes(), ('catalog-copy',str(rel))
migration_src=root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window/window24-20260923-migration.json'
migration_dst=root/'evidence/production-review-v2-lite/migrations/534b8e86c940f0be3dedb147e8e3381b12ec2a101b5b70958e3181b7ad8d41cd.json'
assert migration_dst.read_bytes()==migration_src.read_bytes(), 'migration-copy'
pub=window/'publication'
pairs={
 'PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md':task/'PUBLICATION-SCOPE.md',
 'CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json':task/'CATALOG-CHANGE-VERIFICATION.json',
 'MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json':task/'MIGRATION-HOST-VERIFICATION.json',
 'TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json':task/'TRANSLATION-COMMIT.json',
 'ADJUDICATION-R0.json':task/'ADJUDICATION-R0.json',
 'ADJUDICATION-FINAL.json':task/'ADJUDICATION-FINAL.json',
}
for suffix in ('queue-1.log','queue-1-timing.json','catalog.log','catalog-timing.json','migration.json','migration-timing.json','migration-run.log','migration-run-timing.json'):
    pairs[suffix]=root/'.artifacts/i18n/repair-window'/('window24-20260923-'+suffix)
assert set(p.name for p in pub.iterdir() if p.is_file())==set(pairs)
for name,src in pairs.items():
    assert (pub/name).read_bytes()==src.read_bytes(), ('publication-copy',name)
for p in [window/'PUBLICATION.md',root/'handoff.md',window/'orchestration-pack-manifest.json',migration_dst,*pub.iterdir(),*(root/rel for rel in [
 'evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/entries.jsonl',
 'evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/exclusions.jsonl',
 'evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog/manifest.json',
 'i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite/catalog-v1.schema.json',
 'i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite/policy-v1.json'])]:
    p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
for p in (window/'PUBLICATION.md',root/'handoff.md'):
    lines=p.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    bad=[i for i,s in enumerate(lines,1) if s.rstrip(' \t')!=s]
    assert not bad,(str(p),bad)
link_re=re.compile(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)')
for p in (window/'PUBLICATION.md',root/'handoff.md'):
    for link in link_re.findall(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')):
        if '://' in link or link.startswith('#'): continue
        target=(p.parent/link.split('#',1)[0]).resolve()
        assert target.exists(),('broken-link',str(p),link)
print(json.dumps({
 'pack_files':len(m['files']),
 'pack_manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'catalog_files':5,
 'migration_sha256':hashlib.sha256(migration_dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'publication_attachments':len(pairs),
 'utf8':'ok','trailing_whitespace':'ok','relative_links':'ok'
},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
PY
python3 -B tools/ai_state_check.py .ai/task/repair-w24-20260923/STATE.json --workspace-root /workspace/tome4-chinese-translation/evidence/quality/repair-window-24-20260923/orchestration --target DONE
git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --name-only -- handoff.md evidence/production-review-v2-lite/catalog i18n/quality/production-review-v2-lite",
  workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
  yield_time_ms: 30000,
  max_output_tokens: 20000,
  sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
  justification: "允许我执行 PUBLICATION-SCOPE 指定的只读 SHA/逐字/UTF-8/空白/链接核验和 ai_state_check，并查看最终工作树差异吗？"
});
